# webx-ui/cache

> 标签: cache, invalidation, laravel, versioned-keys, webx-ui

## 简介

Cache on versioned keys for a WebX UI site: named groups of data, one version a group, an entry that goes when any group it was built from moves — on file and database stores as well as Redis.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
